descriptionFull: The greater roadrunner ( Geococcyx californianus ) is a long-legged bird in the cuckoo family, Cuculidae, from Southwestern United States and Mexico. The Latin name means "Californian earth-cuckoo". Along with the lesser roadrunner, it is one of two species in the roadrunner genus Geococcyx . This roadrunner is also known as the chaparral cock, ground cuckoo, and snake killer.
